items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Johnny and (Cue) were on the fourth floor see.

ctx.x: Yes, and we were living at the Ritz Hotel. That's at Oakland Boulevard and South

Parkway. So the Ellington band happened to be in town so Marge came in some kind of way there and she got the floors mixed up. Looked like we were on the third floor and Johnny and (Cue) were on the fourth floor see.
